bio.text: Emily Sirota, a Democrat, has represented District 9 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2019.
According to Ballotpedia, she is not seeking re-election to the House and advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary for Colorado State Senate District 32, on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
Sirota has a B.A. in political science from Indiana University and a Master of Social Work from the University of Denver.
Earlier in her career she worked for the Colorado Progressive Coalition, ran for the Denver school board, and served as a policy aide to a U.S. Senator, a congressman, and a governor.
